rule: Inputs and expected answers were written before any generation. They are not changed after results are seen.

families.Q: Quantitative: correct givens, units, computed answer
families.T: Chronology / attribution: event time vs record time vs accession, who reports what
families.A: Explanation / argument / text: supported interpretation grounded in the supplied text

inputs.brief: Introductory chemistry for 10th graders: 1 lesson of 45 minutes on limiting reagents. Use the reaction 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O with 4 mol H2 and 3 mol O2. Include a quiz with 4 questions per lesson, an assignment and a study guide.
expected: O2 needed for 4 mol H2 is 2 mol

inputs.brief: 初中数学：1节课，45分钟，主题是平均数、中位数和方差。使用数据 3, 5, 5, 7, 10。请包含每节4道题的测验、一份作业和一份学习指南。

Physics for 11th graders: 1 lesson of 45 minutes on constant acceleration. A cart starts from rest and accelerates at 3 m/s^2 for 4 s. Include a quiz with 4 questions per lesson, an assignment and a study guide.
高中生物：1节课，45分钟，主题是孟德尔遗传。用 Aa × Aa 杂交，A 为显性。请包含每节4道题的测验、一份作业和一份学习指南。

History source analysis for 9th graders: 1 lesson of 45 minutes. Source facts: A letter dated 12 March 1850 describes a mill fire that happened in 1848. The writer says he heard about the fire from his brother. The county archive received the letter in 1902. Include a quiz with 4 questions per lesson, an assignment and a study guide.
高一历史史料分析：1节课，45分钟。史料事实：县志记载某石桥建于1623年；桥头碑文记载1631年重修；1980年的旅游手册称该桥建于1631年。请包含每节4道题的测验、一份作业和一份学习指南。
expected: 旅游手册把重修当成建成

inputs.brief: History for 11th graders: 1 lesson of 45 minutes on reading conflicting sources. Source facts: The mill owners' newspaper reported that 300 workers joined the 1912 strike. The union bulletin reported 1,200 strikers. No third count survives. Include a quiz with 4 questions per lesson, an assignment and a study guide.
expected: the true number cannot be settled from these sources
attribute each number to its source

inputs.brief: 高中历史：1节课，45分钟，比较史料。史料事实：一位教师在1937年的日记中写道当天学校停课；同一位教师在1985年出版的回忆录中写道学校照常上课。请包含每节4道题的测验、一份作业和一份学习指南。
expected: 回忆录写于1985年，时间距离远
日记更接近事件但仍需佐证

inputs.brief: English literature for 10th graders: 1 lesson of 45 minutes, close reading of Shelley's Ozymandias. Use these lines: "And on the pedestal, these words appear: My name is Ozymandias, King of Kings; Look on my Works, ye Mighty, and despair! Nothing beside remains. Round the decay Of that colossal Wreck, boundless and bare The lone and level sands stretch far away." Include a quiz with 4 questions per lesson, an assignment and a study guide.
expected: answers grounded in the supplied lines

inputs.brief: 小学语文：1节课，40分钟，学习李白《静夜思》：床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。请包含每节4道题的测验、一份作业和一份学习指南。
初中科学探究：1节课，45分钟，主题是因果推断。材料事实：某校引入平板电脑后一年，平均成绩提高了8分；同一年学校也更换了数学老师。请包含每节4道题的测验、一份作业和一份学习指南。
expected: 同时更换老师是混杂因素
不能断定平板导致提高

inputs.brief: Spanish for beginners: 1 lesson of 45 minutes on introductions with the verb ser. Use this dialogue: "Hola, soy Ana. ¿Cómo te llamas?" "Me llamo Luis. Soy de México. ¿Y tú?" "Soy de España." Include a quiz with 4 questions per lesson, an assignment and a study guide.
